source_issue.title: Listing block headline should integrate with TOC

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a bug in the Volto project where the listing block headline is not properly integrated with the Table of Contents (TOC). Specifically, it involves ensuring the `tocEntry` feature works as intended.

## What needs to be done
You need to investigate the configuration of the listing block and implement the functionality to include a `tocEntry` as per the existing TOC integration strategies. There seems to be a gap in the current implementation where the `tocEntry` is missing from the listing block.

## Helpful background
This issue has been confirmed and has links to related discussions and previous attempts to address it (see [#4436](https://github.com/plone/volto/pull/4436)). However, prior solutions were closed without fully resolving this specific problem. The mechanism for `tocEntries` was added in another pull request (#5146), but the integration within the listing block remains to be addressed.

## Good first steps
1. Review the existing configuration for listing blocks and TOC integration.
2. Familiarize yourself with the `tocEntry` feature in the context of Volto.
3. Check the open comments for insights or suggestions from other contributors.
4. Start working on a potential fix and write tests to ensure it works as expected.
5. Coordinate with the assigned contributor for any questions or guidance.
